title: Import documents, code, or both
benefit: Connect local folders, workspace roots, and Git checkouts to one catalog; add another source type at any time.
prerequisites: Trusted desktop workspace; Git for Git operations.

title: Create OKF where you choose
benefit: Choose a destination, create the first bundle immediately, and review later updates to existing bundles.
prerequisites: A synchronized source repository and writable destination.

title: Keep the catalog current
benefit: Incrementally sync changed files, inspect sync failures, cancel work, and remove catalog entries while retaining sources.
prerequisites: Readable imported roots.

title: Use native Git workflows
benefit: Inspect status/history, switch branches, fetch, pull, commit, push, or clone through VS Code Git.
prerequisites: Git and the built-in Git extension; remote credentials for network actions. Live remote actions: Not Verified.

title: Browse every file
benefit: Expand real folders, open unindexed files, and select indexed files for AI without silently broadening scope.
prerequisites: Imported readable repository; symbolic links are displayed but not followed.

title: Search and inspect evidence
benefit: Search the full index, save views, inspect metadata and source provenance, compare two records, and export portable knowledge.
prerequisites: Synchronized supported sources. Semantic search additionally needs a ready vector index.

title: Trace relationships and impact
benefit: Explore definitions, imports, calls, document links, and requirement-to-code-to-test relations with source jumps.
prerequisites: Extracted relations. Static calls, impact, and coverage are approximate rather than runtime proof.

title: Ask one document or a chosen scope
benefit: Ask about one file, selected files, a folder, one repository, chosen repositories, or the whole workspace.
prerequisites: Indexed sources; a configured chat provider for synthesized answers. Evidence mode works offline.

title: Preview relevant context
benefit: Inspect bounded excerpts, citations, and estimated input tokens before contacting a model; no relevant match means no model call.
prerequisites: A specific lexical query, or selected files for a general summary. Synonym retrieval may need rephrasing.

title: Choose independent chat models
benefit: Use VS Code chat models, Ollama, OpenAI, Azure, or compatible endpoints for cited answers, summaries, comparisons, and drafts.
prerequisites: An available provider/model, credentials where required, and consent. Live provider/client accounts: Not Verified.

title: Configure and test embeddings
benefit: Set the embedding provider/model, chunk size and overlap, and run a synthetic connection test without repository content.
prerequisites: Available embedding service/model. Configuration does not establish a successful connection.

title: Choose vector storage
benefit: Use local vectors, Qdrant, or PostgreSQL/pgvector and test access without changing remote collections or tables.
prerequisites: Remote services require credentials, consent, and deployment configuration. Live remote deployments: Not Verified.

title: Build and evaluate retrieval
benefit: Preview chunks/tokens, build or rebuild, inspect readiness, roll back, clean old namespaces, and compare retrieval scores and latency.
prerequisites: Indexed chunks, configured embeddings, and compatible storage. Scores do not measure model groundedness.

title: Connect agents through MCP
benefit: Discover nine knowledge tools, inspect permissions, and test the packaged stdio runtime and authenticated status call.
prerequisites: Trusted VS Code host with MCP API support. Each consuming client still needs its own setup and verification.

title: Prepare portable context
benefit: Preview and export redacted evidence packs with line citations and a token budget without a model request.
prerequisites: Relevant indexed evidence and a valid scope.

title: Install an optional knowledge agent
benefit: Add a reviewed agent definition and try read-only tools locally before asking a coding agent to use them.
prerequisites: Writable repository and separate human approval; existing agent files are preserved.

title: Find knowledge risks
benefit: Inspect validation, drift, freshness, heuristic coverage, prompt-injection indicators, and sensitive-content warnings.
prerequisites: Indexed sources. These heuristics are not comprehensive security or semantic validation.

title: Review changes safely
benefit: Select all pending changes, inspect a combined diff, approve once, reject proposals, or undo unchanged approved files.
prerequisites: Write permission and unchanged source/target hashes. A failed multi-file write can leave reported partial completion.

title: Export diagnostics and manage local data
benefit: Export redacted diagnostics, review retention, revoke consent, and delete derived indexes without deleting source repositories.
prerequisites: Trusted workspace; destructive local-data actions require confirmation.

title: PR-based team review
benefit: Proposed future review through pull requests, with team governance and audit integration.
prerequisites: Future authenticated Git hosting integration; no PR workflow is implemented.

title: PDF/DOCX and enterprise connectors
benefit: Proposed future safe document adapters and external source connectors.
prerequisites: Not supported in this release; import supported Markdown/text/HTML and TS/JS/Python files.

title: Shared indexes, RBAC, and managed plans
benefit: Proposed future team sharing, access control, managed indexing, and Pro/Team licensing.
prerequisites: Backend, security, and commercial design work; no paid or shared service is implemented.
